title: Inhibitor-free DNA extraction from soil and sediment samples
author: Dominik Buchner

steps.title: Prepare tube with beads
steps.instruction: Label a 50 mL centrifuge tube and add 15 g garnet beads for each sample.

steps.title: Add soil sample
steps.instruction: Add up to 10 g soil (typically 2 g) to the tube; adjust amount based on soil type.

steps.title: Add bead‑beating and lysis solutions
steps.instruction: Add 15 mL bead‑beating solution and 1.2 mL lysis solution, then vortex briefly.

steps.title: Bead‑beat sample
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a vortex adapter (e.g., Qiagen) and vortex at maximum speed for 10 min. Alternatively, incubate at 65 °C for 30 min with maximum RPM or use a thermoblock.

steps.title: Centrifuge and collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Spin at 2500 × g, 20 °C for 3 min; carefully transfer the supernatant to a new tube (pour if large volume).

steps.title: Add ammonium acetate buffer
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL ammonium acetate buffer, vortex briefly, and incubate at 4 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge after buffer
steps.instruction: Spin at 2500 × g, 20 °C for 4 min; transfer the supernatant to a new tube, avoiding the pellet.

steps.title: Add inhibitor removal buffer
steps.instruction: Add 4 mL inhibitor removal buffer (precipitate may form), vortex briefly, and incubate at 4 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge and transfer
steps.instruction: Spin at 2500 × g, 20 °C for 4 min; after clearing, transfer up to 15 mL supernatant to a new tube, avoiding the pellet.

steps.title: Add DNA binding buffer
steps.instruction: Add 30 mL DNA binding buffer and mix by vortexing or inverting.

steps.title: Load mixture onto maxi column
steps.instruction: Transfer the mixture to a maxi spin column (e.g., Epoch Life Science) placed in a 50 mL centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Bind DNA to column
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 2500 × g, 20 °C for 30 s, discard flow‑through, and repeat once to process the full volume.

steps.title: Wash and dry column
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL wash buffer, then centrifuge at 2500 × g, 20 °C for 5 min to wash and dry the column.

steps.title: Elute DNA (incubation)
steps.instruction: Transfer the column to a new tube, add 1 mL elution buffer, and incubate at room temperature for 3 min.

steps.title: Elute DNA (centrifuge)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 2500 × g, 20 °C for 1 min; the eluate should be completely colorless and ready for downstream analysis.

steps.title: Prepare 2 mL tube with beads
steps.instruction: Label a 2 mL centrifuge tube and add 750 mg garnet beads per sample.

steps.title: Add soil or sediment
steps.instruction: Add 500 mg soil or sediment (adjust to 200–250 mg for organic soils or up to 1 g for sandy sediments; test upper limit gradually).

steps.title: Add bead‑beating and lysis solutions
steps.instruction: Add 1380 µL bead‑beating solution and 240 µL lysis solution, then vortex briefly.

steps.title: Bead‑beat sample
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a vortex adapter and vortex at maximum speed for 10 min; alternatively incubate at 65 °C for 30 min with maximum RPM or use a thermoblock.

steps.title: Centrifuge and collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Spin at 10 000 × g, 20 °C for 3 min; transfer 600 µL supernatant to a new tube.

steps.title: Add ammonium acetate buffer
steps.instruction: Add 250 µL ammonium acetate buffer, vortex briefly, and incubate at 4 °C for 5 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge after buffer
steps.instruction: Spin at 10 000 × g, 20 °C for 1 min; transfer supernatant to a new tube.

steps.title: Add inhibitor removal buffer
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL inhibitor removal buffer (precipitate may form), vortex briefly, and incubate at 4 °C for 5 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge and collect
steps.instruction: Spin at 10 000 × g, 20 °C for 1 min; transfer 600 µL supernatant to a new tube.

steps.title: Add DNA binding buffer
steps.instruction: Add 1200 µL DNA binding buffer and vortex to mix.

steps.title: Load mixture onto mini column
steps.instruction: Load 650 µL of the mixture onto a mini spin column (e.g., Epoch Life Science).

steps.title: Bind DNA to mini column
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10 000 × g, 20 °C for 30 s, discard flow‑through, and repeat two more times to bind the complete sample volume.

steps.title: Wash column
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL wash buffer, centrifuge at 10 000 × g, 20 °C for 30 s, and discard flow‑through.

steps.title: Dry column
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10 000 × g, 20 °C for 1 min to dry; transfer the spin column to a clean 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Elute DNA (incubation)
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL elution buffer and incubate at room temperature for 3 min.

steps.title: Elute DNA (centrifuge)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10 000 × g, 20 °C for 1 min; eluate should be completely colorless and ready for downstream analysis.
